productive_outcomes: Analyse selected attested compounds through their components, final head and separately added inflection, retaining the checked whole-word meaning.
Distinguish derivation from inflection in the assigned prefix, noun-suffix, adjective and adverb families; do not infer unrestricted lexical coinage.
Use all productive cells of the complete eighteen selected noun systems and twenty separately defined verbal systems, with their diagnostic stems and exceptions together.

Use each newly assigned ordinary lexical sense and frame, including return, belief, leaving peace, giving, falling upon, praying reflexively, showing, licking, raising, mercy, receiving and providing friends.
Distinguish the new lexical noun gōd goods from the previously taught adjective rihtwīs used substantivally; preserve the actual governed case and agreement.
Complete all twenty-one unchanged Cook VIII.26–27 prompts and the original graded practice, distinguishing grammatical alternatives from explicitly stated vocabulary, number and final-verb controls.
recognition_outcomes: Interpret the complete 159-word source argument through its stated local supports, tracking the tall tree, cliffs, mountains and human conclusion.
Identify the passage’s paired words, repeated height vocabulary and repeated conclusions without mechanically treating near-synonyms as separate events.
Recognize the explicit reference-only noun number cells and supplied citation/source forms without inferring additional productive senses or full unassigned systems.
Distinguish an original source prompt or text from declared formatting normalization, supplied help and new teaching material.
